description: Decide whether data belongs in a table, small multiples, a sparkline or a chart. Pass `rows`, `cols` (numeric columns or series), `purpose` (lookup, compare, pattern, monitor), `precision` (exact or approximate), `space` (inline, tiny, normal, large), `timeSeries` (boolean), `mixedUnits` (boolean), `groups` (how many comparable series or panels could be drawn) and optionally `audience` (general, analyst, executive). Returns `recommendation`, `alternatives`, `reasons` and `cautions`. The logic follows the table-versus-graph reasoning in Stephen Few (Show Me the Numbers) and Edward Tufte's small multiples and sparklines, but the rules and the wording are our own. Pure computation.
name: data_table_vs_chart
title: Table or chart
